name: Ignis Avis Venatio
source:
Cain Blanchard is a fifteen year old boy who wants nothing more than to be left to his own devices. When a cute girl said to be a "phoenix" suddenly drops from the sky before him, Cain is thrust into the world of magic. He inadvertently finds himself caught in a game called Ignis Avis Venatio; a fight to the death competition between students and their familiars. The winner of the game obtains the phoenix's powers. What should he do? Who should he fight? And who exactly is this "phoenix" girl?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/809570/Ignis_Avis_Venatio/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
凯恩·布兰查德是一名15岁男孩，只想独自生活，不被任何人打扰。某天，一个据说是“凤凰”的可爱女孩突然从天而降，凯恩被卷入魔法世界。他无意中参加了名为《Ignis Avis Venatio》的游戏：学生与使魔之间展开的生死竞赛。胜者将获得凤凰之力。他该怎么办？应该和谁战斗？这个“凤凰”女孩究竟是谁？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/809570/Ignis_Avis_Venatio/]Steam[/url]]
